technique_name: What are the advantages of virtual reality?
description: The advantages of virtual reality (VR) include increased engagement, enhanced immersion, increased productivity, improved safety testing, and enhanced entertainment. Increased engagement results from combining audio and visual elements together to create a more realistic and engaging experience. Enhanced immersion results from the ability to experience something that would be impractical or dangerous in physical reality.
